summary: API security hardening: escape chunk text to prevent [DOC]/[/DOC] instruction breakout; cap Mermaid subprocess concurrency; extend Mermaid unsafe-source blacklist to click/href/linkStyle.
final_report: Implemented T5b API security hardening. (1) app/llm/messages.py: added _escape_doc_text() that replaces ASCII [ and ] with fullwidth brackets (U+FF3B/U+FF3D) in chunk text, so uploaded text can no longer close the [DOC] boundary, open a new [DOC block, or inject [APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS]; chunk_block applies it and the DOC header (id/location/file attributes) and citation-marker behavior are untouched; build_chat_messages shape unchanged. (2) app/services/mermaid.py: added a bounded asyncio.Semaphore (_validation_slots) defaulting to 4, configurable via SAGE_MERMAID_MAX_CONCURRENCY env var; validate_mermaid wraps subprocess dispatch in `async with _validation_slots` so excess validations wait rather than crash, and failures still route through the existing mermaid_validator_unavailable path. (3) extended the unsafe-source blacklist (_UNSAFE_SOURCE_TOKENS) with click/href/linkstyle (keeping <script/javascript:/%%{/</script), checked before subprocess dispatch; source-length cap preserved. Tests in tests/test_outputs_security.py: chunk text with [/DOC]/[DOC/[APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS] neutralized, citation header + build_chat_messages shape preserved, click/href/linkStyle rejected, concurrency cap enforced (peak==2 under Semaphore(2)), default cap == 4. Verification: ruff clean (zero issues); focused pytest tests/test_outputs_security.py + tests/test_mermaid.py = 13 passed; related smoke (test_api_chat_sse.py + test_structured_outputs.py + test_api_outputs.py + test_structured.py + test_teach.py) = 73 passed. Full-suite verification handed to Merlin.

HEAD unchanged from base_commit (1b1a231); no concurrent writer touched the declared files. Full pytest suite is Merlin's job, hence analyzer_pending.
